status: User-authorized provisional scenarios; ecological expert approval pending

rationale.forest: Retains the forest-oriented scope and allocates a smaller share to cumulative loss because it overlaps with recent loss. Exact shares are analyst assumptions.
rationale.climate_departure: Both directions of departure/trend are exploratory exposure signals; they are not species-specific harm estimates. Trends receive a smaller share than departures.
rationale.population_pressure: Population density is one pressure proxy. It does not replace roads, built-up area or a full human-footprint index.
rationale.all_domains: Group weights prevent giving a domain extra influence merely because it has more columns. These numerical priorities require ecological review.

sampled_vegetation_sensitivity.interpretation: Sparse point-sampled greenness illustration only. NDVI sensor/date/season/QA provenance is unverified; never use this score as a released HRI or forecasting label.

context_only.annual_mean_temperature_and_precipitatio: Source inputs for reference departures; do not weight both raw values and their departures again.
context_only.elevation_mean_sd_and_slope: Retain as context/species modifiers; generic risk direction is unsupported. No arbitrary high-elevation or steep-slope penalty.
context_only.sampled_elevation: Observation context; duplicates terrain and has uneven sampling.
context_only.sampled_land_cover: Retain product-prefixed categories. Risk mappings await product/version/date verification and ecological justification; do not score integer codes.
context_only.coverage_and_missing_flags: Uncertainty/eligibility only; do not increase or decrease risk using sampling completeness.

missing_policy: Require every positively weighted component. Preserve NaN and report available nominal weight. Never silently renormalize or extrapolate population after 2020.
risk_class_status: Use existing thirds for comparison only; communication thresholds are not ecologically validated.
source_limit: Sources support methods or broad mechanisms; none establishes the exact percentages in this file.
